original_primary_artifacts: Exact preserved bytes, including historical absolute command and report URLs.
portable_replay_inputs: Relative job paths; the frozen runner resolves its new study location.
research_wheels: 47 exact wheel binaries included once in inputs/wheels.
execution_tools: pip 26.2.2 and packaging 26.3 are separately identified post-confirmation support.
host_prerequisites: Recorded CPython 3.12.14, Node 24.22.1 and the exact native target environment. Interpreter, Node and OS binaries are not redistributed. See inputs/execution-tools/tool-closure.json.
default_network_behavior: No network. No automatic package installation or confirmation rerun.
synthetic_fixture_wheels: Retained in the full edition as failure evidence; omitted from GitHub. Public-wheel bootstrap restores primary reproduction dependencies, not every synthetic failure fixture.
reproduction_interpretation: Reuses the same six registered questions for 18 branch evaluations; creates zero new research missions or customer orders. Use a fresh disposable copy.
full_market_ledgers: Included unchanged when present, with raw and compressed identities checked.
manifest: Every included file is hashed. The manifest excludes itself; the outer archive hash binds it.
